step.action: Read 🍳 Refrigerator_Thermometers without leaving refrigerator doors open.
step.ifThen: IF any refrigerator is above 41°F, THEN close its door and tell the Dominatrix immediately.

step.action: Inspect each refrigerator door for a complete seal.
step.ifThen: IF a door does not seal, THEN close it as far as possible and tell the Dominatrix.

step.action: Confirm each refrigerator is receiving power.
step.ifThen: IF a refrigerator has no power, THEN keep its door closed and tell the Dominatrix.

passWhen.criterion: Every refrigerator door is closed and sealed.
